chapter.verse: Tu-in Jerusalem naih ta-in Olive Mual, Bethphage khua a tun uh ciangin Jesu in nungzuite nih sawl a,
“Note' mai-a om khua ah va pai un. Lapi khat khau kikhih na mu pah ding uh a, a no khat zong a gei-ah om ding hi. A nihin a khau sutkhia unla kei' kiang hong paipih un.
Mi khatpeuh in bang khatpeuh hong paupih leh, ‘Topa' ading hih kisam,’ ci un. Amah in late hong phal pah ding hi,” ci-in vaikhak hi.
Hih thu pen kamsangpa' gen a nuai-a thu a tangtun nadinga piang ahi hi:
“Zion' tanu' kiangah gen un, ‘En in, na kumpipa nang' kiang hong pai a, kiniamkhiatin lapi' tung leh vanpua gan khat ii a no ahi lano' tungah tuang hi.’”
Nungzuite zong va pai-in Jesu' sawl bangin hih uh hi.
Lapi leh lano hong paipih uh a, tuate' tungah a puante uh phahin a tungah Jesu tuang hi.
Mihon tampite in lampi tungah a puante uh phah uh a, a dangte in singkung pan singhiang khiakin lampi tungah tuate phah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' mai-a pai mihonpi leh a nunga zui mihonpi awng uh a, “David' Tapa, Hosanna! Topa' min tawh hong pai mipa, thuphangah ahi hi! Sangbelna ah Hosanna!” ci uh hi.
Jerusalem khuasung a lut ciangin khuapi bup kisosuah henhan uh a, “Hih kua ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin mihonpite in, “Galilee gam Nazareth khua pana kamsang Jesu hi,” ci-in dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin biakinnpi ah Jesu lut a, biakinnpi sunga vanzuak vanlei mi khempeuh hawlkhia-in sumkhekte' sabuaite leh vakhu zuakte' tutphahte sawnpaai hi.
Tua mite' kiangah, “‘Ka innpi pen thungetna inn kici ding hi,’ ci-in kigelh hinapi note in guta buluhte' bukna kua na suaksak uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin biakinnpi sung, Jesu' kiangah khuamulote leh khebaite hong pai uh a, Jesu in amaute damsak hi.
Ahih hangin siampi liante leh laisiamte in Jesu' bawl a lamdang thute leh “David' Tapa, Hosanna!” ci-a biakinnpi sunga kiko naupangte a muh uh ciangin a heh uh suak a,

Jesu' kiangah, “Hihte in bang gen cih na za hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi. Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Ka za hi. Hih, simkha ngeilo na hi uh hiam? “‘Naungekte leh nawinete' kam sungpan phatna na gingkhiasak hi.’ ”
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute nusia a, tua khuapi pan paikhia-in Bethany khua ah giak hi.
Zingsang ciangin khuapi ah hong paikik laitak Jesu gilkial hi.

Lam gei-ah theikung khat mu ahih manin a phung a va pai leh a tehte longal bangmah dang mu lo hi. Tua ciangin theikung' kiangah, “A tawntungin nang' tungpan gah piangkik nawnkei ta hen!” ci hi. Tua phetin theikung keugaw pah hi.
Thupiang a muh uh ciangin nungzuite in lamdang sa uh a, “Bangci-a theikung keugaw thei pah hiam?” ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Maantak kong cihin ah note in muanglah lo-in upna na neih nak uhleh hih theikung tunga piang bangin hihthei bek thamlo, hih mual' kiangah, ‘Kikhaangto inla tuipi sung kidenna in,’ ci phial taleh uhcin tua bangin piang ding hi.
Tua hi a, upna na neih nak uhleh thungetna tawh na nget peuhpeuh uh na ngah ding uh hi.”

Biakinnpi sungah Jesu lutin thu a hilhcian laitak siampi liante leh Jew makaite a kiangah hong pai uh a, “Bang thuneihna tawh hih nate sem na hi hiam? Tua thuneihna kua'n hong pia hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in, “Ke'n zong thu khat kong dong ding a, nong dawn uhleh hih nate bang thuneihna tawh sem ka hiam, cih kong gen ding hi.

John' baptizena thu koi pan hong pai ahi hiam? Vantung pan hiam, mite' kiangpan hiam?” ci-in dong hi. Tua ciangin tua mite khatlekhat kikum uh a, “Eite in, ‘Vantung pan hi,’ ci lehang, amah'n, ‘Tua ahihleh bang hangin note in John um lo na hi uh hiam?’ hong ci ding hi.
Ahih hangin, ‘Mite' kiangpan hi,’ ci lehang lah mi khempeuh in John pen kamsang khatin pom uh ahih manin amaute i kihta zel hi,” kici uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute in Jesu dawng uh a, “Ka thei kei uh hi,” ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesu in tua mite' kiangah, “Ke'n zong hihte bang thuneihna tawh ka sep cih kong gen kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin dong hi: “Note in na bangci ngaihsut uh hiam? Mi khat in tapa nih nei hi. A masapa' kiangah amah pai-in, ‘Ka ta aw, tuni-in lenggah lo ah kuanin na va sem in,’ ci hi.
A tapa in, ‘Ka kuan kei ding hi,’ ci-in dawng hi. Himah taleh a den ciangin lungnuamlo kikin va kuan hi.
Tua ciangin a tapa dang khat' kiangah pai-in a thu kibang mah va gen hi. A tapa in, ‘Topa aw, ka va kuan ding hi,’ ci napi-in kuan lo hi.

Nihte' lakah kuazaw in a pa' deihna mang ahi hiam?” Tua mite in, “A masapa,” ci-in dawng uh hi. Jesu in hih bangin gensuak hi: “Maantak kong cihin ah note' ma-in siahdongte leh numei kizuakte Pasian' kumpigam sung lut uh hi.

A hang pen note' kiangah diktatna lampi tawnin John hong pai napi amah na um kei uh a, ahi zongin siahdongte leh numei kizuakte in amah um uh hi. Tua thu na muh khit uh nangawn lungnuamlo tuanlo-in amah na um kei veve uh hi.

“Thugenteh dang khat na ngai lai un. Loneipu khat in lenggah lo nei-in a kimkot ah gawl bawl hi. Lo sungah lengtui bawlna dum khat to-in lo vilna tausang khat zong lam hi. Tua ciangin lokhawhlawhte cial a, amah ahihleh khualzin hi.
Lenggah min hun a nai ciangin ama' ngahding gahte a la dingin loneipu in lokhawhlawhte' kiangah a silate sawl hi.
Lokhawhlawhte in tua silate na mancip uh a, khat satin, khat thatin, khat suang tawh deng uh hi.
Tua ciangin loneipu in a silate, a masa sangin a tamzaw, paisak leuleu hi. Lokhawhlawhte in zong a masa lai mah bangin na bawl veve uh hi.
A tawpna ah, ‘Ka tapa na thupisim buang ding uh hi,’ ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin a tapa sawl hi.
Ahih hangin loneipu' tapa a muh uh ciangin lokhawhlawhte amau teng kiho uh a, ‘Hih pa innluahpa hi. Hong pai un, hih pa thatin ama' gamhluah ding teng tang ni,’ ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah man uh a, lenggah lo pualam ah kaikhia-in that uh hi.
Tua bang ahih manin loneipu hong pai ciangin tua lokhawhlawhte bang a cih ding hiam?”

Amaute in dawng uh a, “Amah in tua migilote' tungah siatna lianpi tungsak ding a, tua khit ciangin a lo pen lenggah lak hun simin ama' ngahding zah a pia ding lokhawhlawh dangte semsak ding hi,” ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Pasian' Laibupi sungah hih thu simkha ngeilo na hi uh hiam?: ‘Innlamte' nilkhiat suangtum, khuambul suangpi suak khinta hi; hih pen Topa' sep hi a, eite' mit ah a lamdangpi ahi hi.’
“Tua thu hangin kong cihin ah note' kiangpan Pasian' kumpigam kilakhia ding a, gahleteh a piangsak minam khat' tungah kipia ding hi.
Tua suang tunga a tuk mite kitatzan mang ding a, mi khatpeuh tungah tua suang a tuk leh zong dengzan gawp ding hi.”
Jesu' thugentehte a zak uh ciangin siampi liante leh Pharisee-te in amau' thu a gen ahihlam thei uh hi.
Jesu mat ding a sawmnop uh hangin mihonpi kihta uh hi. A hang pen mihonpi in Jesu kamsang khatin pom uh ahih man hi.
